sentences.en: Hi, I'm Andrew Ross-Sorkin.
sentences.zh: 嗨，我是安德鲁·罗斯-索尔金。

sentences.en: I cover business and policy for Dealbook, a daily newsletter at the
sentences.zh: 我负责《纽约时报》每日简讯《Dealbook》的商业与政策报道。

sentences.en: New York Times.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》。

sentences.en: On November 18th, I'm going to be interviewing some of the most consequential leaders in business, politics, and culture, including J.D.
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我将在纽约市的Dealbook峰会上，现场采访商界、政界和文化界最具影响力的几位领袖，包括J.D.

sentences.en: Vance, Elon Musk, Christine
sentences.zh: 万斯、埃隆·马斯克、克里斯蒂娜·

sentences.en: Lagarde, Zylran Mondani, and many others, live on stage at the Dealbook Summit in New York City.
sentences.zh: 拉加德、齐尔兰·蒙达尼以及许多其他人。

sentences.en: You can watch some of these unguarded, unfiltered conversations as they happen.
sentences.zh: 你可以实时观看其中一些毫无防备、未经过滤的对话。

sentences.en: We're going to be live streaming select interviews for anyone to watch free at nytimes.com on
sentences.zh: 我们将在11月18日于nytimes.com上直播精选采访，供任何人免费观看。

sentences.en: November 18th.
If you're not already a subscriber, you can download the New York Times app to watch and get a month of free access to all of our journalism.
sentences.zh: 如果你还不是订阅者，可以下载《纽约时报》应用程序来观看，并免费获得我们所有新闻内容一个月的访问权限。

sentences.en: I hope you'll tune in.
sentences.zh: 我希望你能收看。

sentences.en: You won't want to miss it.
sentences.zh: 你一定不想错过。

sentences.en: From the New York Times, I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 来自《纽约时报》，我是迈克尔·巴尔巴罗。

sentences.en: This is The Daily, today.
sentences.zh: 这就是今天的《每日新闻》。

sentences.en: In the middle of the pandemic, China has expelled journalists from The Wall Street Journal,
sentences.zh: 在疫情期间，中国驱逐了《华尔街日报》、

sentences.en: The Washington Post, and The New York Times.
sentences.zh: 《华盛顿邮报》和《纽约时报》的记者。

sentences.en: One of those reporters, my colleague Paul Moser, recounts his final days there.
sentences.zh: 其中一位记者，我的同事保罗·莫瑟，讲述了他在那里的最后几天。

sentences.en: It's Thursday, April 16.
sentences.zh: 今天是4月16日，星期四。

sentences.en: Paul Moser, tell us about these text messages that you got a few weeks ago.
sentences.zh: 保罗·莫瑟，给我们讲讲你几周前收到的这些短信吧。

sentences.en: So it's late, probably a bit after midnight,
sentences.zh: 那是深夜，大概午夜刚过，

sentences.en: and I am in Shanghai in my apartment where I've lived for the past three years.
sentences.zh: 我在上海的公寓里，我已经在这里住了三年。

sentences.en: And I'm doing that thing where you're trying to read in bed, but the phone keeps buzzing.
sentences.zh: 我当时正在做那种你在床上试图读书、但手机却一直在震动的事。

sentences.en: And I've told myself this is the last time I'm going to check.
sentences.zh: 我曾告诉自己这是最后一次查看。

sentences.en: And I look at the phone for the first time ever when I've picked my phone while I'm trying to sleep.
sentences.zh: 这是我生平第一次在试图睡觉时拿起手机看一眼。

sentences.en: It's actually relevant.
sentences.zh: 结果居然真的有关系。

sentences.en: And so what I see is one of my colleagues in our sort of private chat group for covering the coronavirus sends a message.
sentences.zh: 我看到的是，我们在报道冠状病毒的私人聊天群里，一位同事发了一条消息。

sentences.en: And it's a memo from the Ministry of Foreign Affairs in China.
sentences.zh: 那是中国外交部的一份备忘录。

sentences.en: And, you know, the first bit, it's all kind of stock language.
sentences.zh: 你知道，第一部分全都是些套话。

sentences.en: It's not too big a deal.
sentences.zh: 没多大关系。

sentences.en: But then I get to point two, and I read point two, and I have to read it again.
sentences.zh: 但当我看到第二点，读了第二点之后，我不得不重新读一遍。

sentences.en: Because what it says in this roundabout way is basically that the entire staff of the New
sentences.zh: 因为上面以这种转弯抹角的方式表达的意思基本上是，整个《纽约时报》的

sentences.en: York Times, all of our reporters in China have to leave the country in just a few weeks.
sentences.zh: 全体员工、我们在中国的所有记者必须在短短几周内离开这个国家。

sentences.en: We've effectively been expelled.
sentences.zh: 我们实际上被驱逐了。

sentences.en: It's not just us that it's been thrown out.
sentences.zh: 被赶出去的不仅仅是我们。

sentences.en: It's also a number of reporters with the Wall Street Journal and the Washington PoSt. So this is the greater part of the U.S.
sentences.zh: 还有《华尔街日报》和《华盛顿邮报》的一些记者。所以这是美国在中国的

sentences.en: press core in China being tossed.
sentences.zh: 记者团的大部分人被驱逐出境。

sentences.en: So you're on your phone in bed looking at a memo that basically says your job in China is over.
sentences.zh: 所以你当时躺在床上看着手机上的一份备忘录，它基本上说你在中国的职业生涯结束了。

sentences.en: Yes, our time is up.
sentences.zh: 是的，我们的时间到了。

sentences.en: As you're looking at this, what are your colleagues and you saying to each other as you're digesting this information from the Chinese government?
sentences.zh: 当你看着这个时，你和你的同事在消化中国政府的这个消息时都在对彼此说些什么？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: You know, I think I'm the first to weigh in and I say, let me be the first to say this
sentences.zh: 你知道，我想我是第一个发表意见的，我说，请允许我成为第一个说出这个

sentences.en: expletive.
sentences.zh: 粗口的人。

sentences.en: You know, fuck.
sentences.zh: 你知道，他妈的。

sentences.en: And then that kind of starts it off.
sentences.zh: 然后这就成了一个开头。

sentences.en: There's, you know, some agreement about that.
sentences.zh: 你知道，大家对此表示了一些赞同。

sentences.en: There's various other kind of, you know, expressions of shock.
sentences.zh: 还有各种其他类型的，你知道的，震惊的表达。

sentences.en: And then our Asia editor,
sentences.zh: 然后我们的亚洲编辑，

sentences.en: Adrian Carter, weighs in and says, you know, we're still trying to figure out what this means.
sentences.zh: 阿德里安·卡特，发表意见说，我们仍在试图弄清楚这意味着什么。

sentences.en: We're good.
sentences.zh: 我们很好。

sentences.en: I think we knew for a long time that it was possible our days were numbered.
sentences.zh: 我想我们很早就知道我们的日子可能屈指可数了。

sentences.en: But even if you kind of know that the Chinese government isn't happy with you, the idea of kind of closing a chapter of,
sentences.zh: 但即使你心里知道中国政府对你不满，一想到要合上长达

sentences.en: you know, more than 13 years of your life spent focusing on a place, learning a language, being there is just impossible to kind of deal with instantly.
sentences.zh: 十三年多的人生篇章——把精力放在一个地方、学习一门语言、身处其中——这种感觉根本无法在一瞬间接受。

sentences.en: It just felt totally surreal.
sentences.zh: 这感觉完全像是一场超现实的梦。

sentences.en: So I kind of wandered out to my balcony and it was a cool kind of, you know, the fog was coming into Shanghai and it was sort of just a dark night.
sentences.zh: 所以我有点漫无目的地走到阳台上，那是那种微凉的、你知道的，雾气正笼罩着上海，那是一个昏暗的夜晚。

sentences.en: And I just kind of spent the next hour or two just sort of outside thinking.
sentences.zh: 接下来的一个多小时里，我只是独自待在外面思考。

sentences.en: It was sort of a nostalgic mess in a way.
sentences.zh: 从某种意义上说，那是一团怀旧的乱麻。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: So this is basically a large scale media purge.
sentences.zh: 所以这基本上是一场大规模的媒体清洗。

sentences.en: I wonder what explanation the Chinese government gives for this, because it feels like this violates decades of journalistic tradition, right?
sentences.zh: 我很想知道中国政府对此作出了什么解释，因为感觉这违背了数十年的新闻传统，对吧？

sentences.en: Where the U.S.
sentences.zh: 即美国

sentences.en: has reporters in China and China has reporters in the U.S.
sentences.zh: 在中国有记者，中国在美国也有记者。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Ostensibly, it's a tit for tat.
sentences.zh: 表面上看，这是一场针锋相对的报复。

sentences.en: A few weeks ago, the Trump administration put a cap on the number of Chinese journalists who work for state media that can be in the United States.
sentences.zh: 几周前，特朗普政府对在美国工作的中国官媒记者人数设定了上限。

sentences.en: And
sentences.zh: 而

sentences.en: China calls this an effective expulsion of 60 Chinese media workers.
sentences.zh: 中国称这是对60名中国媒体工作者的实际驱逐。

sentences.en: So this is the response from the Chinese government to throw us out.
sentences.zh: 所以这是中国政府将我们赶出去的反应。

sentences.en: But there's a lot more to it than that.
sentences.zh: 但事情远不止于此。

sentences.en: It becomes really clear pretty quickly after because a commentary goes up on state media, you know, and ask the question, why are these journalists being thrown out?
sentences.zh: 在这之后很快就变得非常明朗，因为官媒上发表了一篇评论文章，你知道的，提出了一个问题：为什么要把这些记者赶出去？

sentences.en: And it doesn't bring up the United
sentences.zh: 它没有提及美国

sentences.en: States.
What it goes into is our coverage.
sentences.zh: 它谈到的是我们的报道。

sentences.en: And it says that we, you know, were overly critical and biased in attacking the Chinese government and how it responded to the coronavirus, that we were biased
sentences.zh: 它说我们，你知道，对中国政府及其应对冠状病毒的方式的攻击过于批判和偏颇，我们

sentences.en: against China generally.
sentences.zh: 总体上对中国抱有偏见。

sentences.en: And then it also brings up Xinjiang.
sentences.zh: 然后它还提到了新疆。

sentences.en: And it says that the stories that we told over the past year about Uyghurs being locked away in camps are exaggerated and false and just not the true narrative.
sentences.zh: 它说我们在过去一年里关于维吾尔族人被关进营地的报道被夸大了、是虚假的，根本不是真实的情况。

sentences.en: And so I think at that point, you kind of see, yes, on the one hand, this is a tit for tat.
sentences.zh: 所以我想在那个时候，你就会发现，一方面，这确实是一场针锋相对的报复。

sentences.en: But on the other hand, it's about so much more.
sentences.zh: 但另一方面，事情远比这要宏大得多。

sentences.en: So once you have more or less made peace with the fact that you're going to be kicked out, what do you do?
sentences.zh: 那么，一旦你多多少少接受了自己将被驱逐的事实，你接下来会做什么？

sentences.en: Well, you do what you have to do when you have to leave very quickly.
sentences.zh: 嗯，当必须非常迅速地离开时，你该做什么就得做什么。

sentences.en: I start buying plane tickets and you can't think of a worse time to be thrown out of a country because borders are closing all over and any flight has some level of virus risk.
sentences.zh: 我开始买机票，你简直想不出还有比这更糟糕的被驱逐出一个国家的时间了，因为到处都在关闭边境，而且任何航班都存在一定程度的病毒风险。

sentences.en: And so I get a flight ticket to the United States.
sentences.zh: 于是我买了一张去美国的机票。

sentences.en: I get one to Japan.
sentences.zh: 我买了一张去日本的。

sentences.en: I get one to Korea.
sentences.zh: 我买了一张去韩国的。

sentences.en: I get three tickets.
sentences.zh: 我买了两三张机票。

sentences.en: And then as borders are closing, I actually buy two more, sort of more close to my date so I can get out quicker before these borders close.
sentences.zh: 然后随着边境不断关闭，我又买了两张更接近我出发日期的机票，这样我就可以在这些边境关闭之前更快地离开。

sentences.en: But then I realized I have a few days left and I have a bit of this, well, the sort of dilemma, right?
sentences.zh: 但后来我意识到我只剩几天时间了，我心里产生了一种，嗯，类似两难的境地，对吧？

sentences.en: Because I was supposed to go on a reporting trip the day I heard about this thing and we canceled it.
sentences.zh: 因为我本打算在听到这个消息的当天去进行一次采访旅行，但我们取消了。

sentences.en: But, you know, in my experience in journalism has been you always go out when you can.
sentences.zh: 不过，你知道，我做新闻的经验一直是，只要有可能，你总是要出去。

sentences.en: And so I decided, OK, one last hurrah.
sentences.zh: 所以我决定，好吧，最后狂欢一次。

sentences.en: Here we go.
sentences.zh: 我们走吧。

sentences.en: And what is this reporting trip?
sentences.zh: 这是一次什么样的采访行程？

sentences.en: Well, it's supposed to be a pretty routine article.
sentences.zh: 嗯，这本应该是一篇相当常规的文章。

sentences.en: China at this point, is getting back to normal.
sentences.zh: 当时的中国正在恢复正常。

sentences.en: Life is starting to return to the rhythms that had been there pre-epidemic.
sentences.zh: 生活开始回到疫情前的那种节奏中。

sentences.en: So the idea is to find a sort of more middle class town and go there and talk to people and see how dazed they are, how excited they are to be out, that kind of thing.
sentences.zh: 所以我们的想法是找一个比较中产阶级的城镇去那里和人们交谈，看看他们有多茫然，出门有多兴奋，诸如此类的事情。

sentences.en: And so we choose the town of Hefei, which is a city about three or four hours away from Shanghai by train.
sentences.zh: 于是我们选择了合肥这座城市，从上海坐火车过去大约需要三到四个小时。

sentences.en: And my colleague and I plan the trip and we decide to go there for two days and see what life is like there.
sentences.zh: 我和同事计划了这次行程，决定去那里待两天，看看那里的生活是什么样的。

sentences.en: So we go to this mall to try to do some interviews.
sentences.zh: 于是我们去了一家购物中心试图进行一些采访。

sentences.en: The checkpoints are out.
sentences.zh: 检查站已经设立了。

sentences.en: To get into the mall, you need to have your temperature taken by a guard.
sentences.zh: 要进入商场，你需要由保安为你测量体温。

sentences.en: You need to write down your personal information.
sentences.zh: 你需要写下你的个人信息。

sentences.en: And we start talking to a construction worker.
sentences.zh: 我们开始和一名建筑工人交谈。

sentences.en: And within a few minutes, a police officer comes in and sort of beckons him.
sentences.zh: 几分钟之内，一名警察走了过来并向他招了招手。

sentences.en: He basically disappears.
sentences.zh: 他基本上就消失了。

sentences.en: And we ask him what happened.
sentences.zh: 我们问他发生了什么事。

sentences.en: He said, oh, the police officer said, you know, no assembly here because of the virus.
sentences.zh: 他说，哦，警察说，由于病毒原因，这里不允许聚集。

sentences.en: So we move on.
sentences.zh: 于是我们继续前行。

sentences.en: And what becomes apparent is the police officer, he's stripped off his jacket to go undercover.
sentences.zh: 显而易见的是，这名警察脱掉了夹克去执行便衣任务。

sentences.en: And he is following us, kind of diving into stores when we look back to see him and kind of peeking from behind clothing racks to look at what we're doing.
sentences.zh: 他一直在跟着我们，当我们回头看他时他就闪进商店里，从衣架后面探出头来观察我们在做什么。

sentences.en: So we say, all right, well, let's get out of here.
sentences.zh: 所以我们说，好吧，那我们离开这里吧。

sentences.en: So we hop in a car and we go across town to a pedestrian shopping street.
sentences.zh: 于是我们跳上一辆车，穿过全城来到一条步行购物街。

sentences.en: We seem to have lost him.
sentences.zh: 我们似乎把他甩掉了。

sentences.en: We're like, okay.
sentences.zh: 我们想，好吧。

sentences.en: So we're walking down and we hear this sort of this beat, right?
sentences.zh: 于是我们走着走着，听到了这种节奏，对吧？

sentences.en: The beat of pop music.
sentences.zh: 流行音乐的节奏。

sentences.en: And there's this fantastic scene.
sentences.zh: 然后看到了一个非常棒的场景。

sentences.en: It's the storefront of China Gold, which sells jewelry.
sentences.zh: 那是出售珠宝的“中国黄金”的店面。

sentences.en: And all the staff are out in front doing these coordinated dance moves.
sentences.zh: 所有的员工都在前面跳着整齐划一的舞蹈动作。

sentences.en: They're trying to drum up business.
sentences.zh: 他们正在努力招揽生意。

sentences.en: And they invite us in.
sentences.zh: 他们邀请我们进去。

sentences.en: They say, you know, oh yeah, we're happy to talk.
sentences.zh: 他们说，你知道，哦，是的，我们很乐意聊聊。

sentences.en: And so one guy says, you know, for all our dancing, it's not helping that much.
sentences.zh: 于是其中一个人说，你知道，我们跳了这么多舞，其实没多大用处。

sentences.en: People want to get out, but nobody has any money to spend.
sentences.zh: 人们都想出来，但谁也没有钱花。

sentences.en: And we're starting to kind of sit down and sort of set up to talk to him longer.
sentences.zh: 我们正准备坐下来，开始和他进行更长时间的交谈。

sentences.en: And we look up and who's coming in the store behind him, but that same police officer.
sentences.zh: 我们抬头一看，谁正从他身后的店里走进来，不正是那个警察吗。

sentences.en: And he goes in the back, has a word with the manager.
sentences.zh: 他走到后面，跟经理说了几句话。

sentences.en: And just a few minutes later, the guy kind of says, you know what?
sentences.zh: 仅仅几分钟后，那个人就有点抱歉地说，你知道吗？

sentences.en: Like,
sentences.zh: 就像，

sentences.en: I'm sorry, I can't talk.
sentences.zh: 对不起，我不能说话了。

sentences.en: So the police are clearly attempting to block your reporting.
sentences.zh: 所以警察显然在试图阻止你们的报道。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: So I get a little frustrated, but you know, you can't get rid of these guys.
sentences.zh: 所以我有点沮丧，但你知道，你无法摆脱这些人。

sentences.en: And so they're basically on us for the rest of the time.
sentences.zh: 所以他们在我们剩下的时间里基本上一直缠着我们。

sentences.en: And it's becomes almost impossible to talk to any regular person about what would be an overwhelmingly positive story.
sentences.zh: 这使得与任何普通人谈论任何本应是非常积极的故事变得几乎不可能。

sentences.en: Well, I feel like being surveilled by the Chinese authorities is now a somewhat familiar feeling for you when you go on a reporting trip.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我觉得对于你来说，去进行一次采访行程却遭到中国当局的监视，现在已经是一种多少有些熟悉的感觉了。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: You know, I was thinking about it and I think it's maybe been a dozen times over the past year that I've had to deal with security.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我仔细想了想，在过去的一年里，我大概有十二次不得不应对安保人员。

sentences.en: But the thing is with something that's sort of a more basic story like this, you don't normally get this kind of attention.
sentences.zh: 但问题是，对于像这样比较基础的故事，你通常不会受到这种关注。

sentences.en: I mean, that's the kind of thing you get in really, really sensitive stories where they know you're coming and they've
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，那是你在处理非常、非常敏感的故事时才会遇到的情况，他们知道你要来，并且

sentences.en: prepared for you and they really don't want you to learn anything.
sentences.zh: 已经为你做好了准备，他们真的不想让你知道任何事情。

sentences.en: So the idea that just talking to regular people feels so dangerous to them that they're putting this kind of effort in, I mean, that's different and it's extreme for sure.
sentences.zh: 所以，仅仅是和普通人说话对他们来说都觉得如此危险，以至于他们要付出这种努力，我的意思是，这确实不同寻常而且极其过分。

sentences.en: So what happens next?
sentences.zh: 接下来发生了什么？

sentences.en: Well, you know, we go on a walk across the park and we end up at a McDonald's.
sentences.zh: 嗯，你知道，我们穿过公园散步，最后来到了一家麦当劳。

sentences.en: So, you know, we're talking about leaving and how frustrated we are by what's happened.
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道，我们在谈论离开的事情，以及对发生的事情感到多么沮丧。

sentences.en: And a man is kind of eating behind us and he gets up and as he's walking out the door, he turns to me and he says, foreign trash.
sentences.zh: 一个男人在我们身后吃东西，他站起身来，正当他走向门口时，他转过身对我说，外国垃圾。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: You know, we both kind of look up and we're sort of shocked, right?
sentences.zh: 你知道，我们俩都抬头看了看，有点震惊，对吧？

sentences.en: And so look at him and he says, yeah, you foreign trash.
sentences.zh: 所以我看着他说，对，你们这些外国垃圾。

sentences.en: What are you doing in my country?
sentences.zh: 你们在我的国家做什么？

sentences.en: And then he turns to my Chinese colleague and he says, you bitch, what are you doing with him?
sentences.zh: 然后他转向我的中国同事说，你个贱人，你跟他鬼混什么呢？

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: You bitch.
sentences.zh: 你个贱人。

sentences.en: And so she starts wanting to kind of defend me and she's very upset.
sentences.zh: 于是她开始想要为我辩护，她非常生气。

sentences.en: And I have to basically tell her, you know, don't yell back.
sentences.zh: 而我基本上不得不告诉她，你知道的，别回骂他。

sentences.en: He's menacingly hovering over us.
sentences.zh: 他气势汹汹地盘旋在我们上方。

sentences.en: It does feel like it could, you know, get physical very easily.
sentences.zh: 感觉确实很容易，你知道的，演变成肢体冲突。

sentences.en: And after a few minutes of kind of basically mumbling more nastiness at us, he leaves.
sentences.zh: 在他对我们嘟囔了更多难听的话几分钟后，他离开了。

sentences.en: Nobody says anything and everybody goes back to eating and we try to calm ourselves down.
sentences.zh: 没有人说话，大家都回去继续吃饭，我们试图让自己平静下来。

sentences.en: And Paul, what did you make of that attack from this random stranger?
sentences.zh: 保罗，你对这个素不相识的人的挑衅有什么看法？

sentences.en: Well, you know, I mean, as a foreigner, you stand out in China and, you know, there's a lot of good attention that brings and there's some negative attention over the years.
sentences.zh: 嗯，你知道的，我的意思是，作为一个外国人，你在中国很显眼，你知道的，这会带来很多善意的关注，但这些年来也有一些负面关注。

sentences.en: But I think there had been a real uptick in xenophobia lately.
sentences.zh: 但我认为最近仇外情绪确实有所抬头。

sentences.en: Online, we've seen a lot more nastiness on the
sentences.zh: 在网上，我们看到更多的恶意言论在

sentences.en: Chinese internet about foreigners.
sentences.zh: 中国互联网上针对外国人。

sentences.en: And a lot of foreigners are starting to talk about run-ins they've had.
sentences.zh: 许多外国人开始谈论他们遭遇的冲突。

sentences.en: You know, the reason we went to Hofe in the first place is it was one of the few places we could find a hotel that would accept a foreigner.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，我们当初去合肥的原因是，那是我们能找到的少数几家愿意接待外国人的酒店之一。

sentences.en: I called about 30 hotels and these are American chains, you know, the Hilton and the Marriott.
sentences.zh: 我打了大约30家酒店的电话，这些都是美国连锁酒店，你知道的，希尔顿和万豪。

sentences.en: None of them would accept a foreigner.
sentences.zh: 它们没有一家肯接待外国人。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: And so
sentences.zh: 所以

sentences.en: Hofe was partially because we found a Westin that would take us.
sentences.zh: 部分是因为我们找到了威斯汀愿意接待我们，才去了合肥。

sentences.en: Paul, at this point, you're describing a bunch of experiences that have happened to you in the past, but are happening a lot more intensely in this moment?
sentences.zh: 保罗，此时此刻，你正在描述过去发生在你身上的一系列经历，但这些经历在当下正以更强烈的方式发生着？

sentences.en: Government surveillance, anti-Westernism, and of course, you're about to be kicked out of the country by the government.
sentences.zh: 政府监控、反西方主义，当然，你即将被政府驱逐出境。

sentences.en: So are you starting to suspect that this is all linked?
sentences.zh: 所以你开始怀疑这一切都是有关联的吗？

sentences.en: Yeah, I think it all feels a part of the same thing.
sentences.zh: 是的，我认为这一切都感觉是同一件事的一部分。

sentences.en: And, you know, everything has been so extreme with the virus.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道的，围绕病毒的一切都太极端了。

sentences.en: There's so much fear and there's so much anger.
sentences.zh: 有那么多的恐惧，也有那么多的愤怒。

sentences.en: There's just so much that feels so heightened that it feels different and it feels like we're kind of at a point of change.
sentences.zh: 有太多让人感觉高度紧张的东西，以至于它感觉不同了，而且感觉我们似乎正处于一个转折点。

sentences.en: And it's not good.
sentences.zh: 这可不是什么好事。

sentences.en: It's not good for, you know, a foreigner in the country, but it's also probably not good for the country itself.
sentences.zh: 对于你知道的，身处国内的外国人来说这不是好事，但对国家本身来说可能也不是好事。

sentences.en: It feels like there's a kind of rejection of what I had thought was an openness to the world in China.
sentences.zh: 感觉人们在排斥我原以为中国对世界保持开放的态度。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: The New York Times app?
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》应用程序？

sentences.en: Unlocked?
sentences.zh: 已解锁？

sentences.en: Paul, where do you think this rejection?
sentences.zh: 保罗，你认为这种排斥情绪

sentences.en: Of the outside world?
sentences.zh: 对外部世界的排斥？

sentences.en: This really heightened version of surveillance and xenophobia?
sentences.zh: 这种高度升级的监控和排外情绪？

sentences.en: Where's this coming from in this moment?
sentences.zh: 此刻这一切究竟从何而来？

sentences.en: The Chinese government.
sentences.zh: 中国政府。

sentences.en: And I think maybe one way that's interesting to think about it is through the lens of the virus.
sentences.zh: 我想也许可以从病毒的视角来思考这个问题，这会是一个很有趣的角度。

sentences.en: So, you know, by all rights, the virus appears to start in Wuhan and kind of spreads out from there.
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道的，根据种种迹象，病毒似乎起源于武汉，并从那里扩散开来。

sentences.en: But I don't remember precisely when this was, but a Chinese scientist, you know, at some point comes out and says, well, we don't know precisely where it came from.
sentences.zh: 但我不记得具体是什么时候了，有个中国科学家，你知道的，在某个时候站出来说，嗯，我们不知道它究竟源自哪里。

sentences.en: We don't know precisely, you know, the first patient or how the first person got infected.
sentences.zh: 我们不知道具体，你知道的，第一个病人是谁，或者第一个人是怎么感染的。

sentences.en: And then what happens is Chinese state media and Chinese officials seize on this to say,
sentences.zh: 然后发生的事情是，中国官媒和中国官员抓住这一点宣称，

sentences.en: it seems like maybe it didn't come from China at all, that it could come from somewhere else.
sentences.zh: 似乎这病毒根本不是来自中国，它可能来自其他地方。

sentences.en: They're saying that this virus didn't come from Wuhan.
sentences.zh: 他们在说这个病毒不是来自武汉。

sentences.en: You know, they aren't that pointed about it at firSt. They just kind of inject this skepticism.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，他们起初并没有那么直白。他们只是注入了这种怀疑态度。

sentences.en: And so then what starts to happen is rumors start to spread.
sentences.zh: 于是接下来开始发生的是，谣言开始传播。

sentences.en: You know, one thing you hear is that, oh, well, the U.S.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，你听到的一件事是，哦，嗯，美国

sentences.en: has a really bad flu season and the U.S.
sentences.zh: 有一个非常糟糕的流感季，而美国

sentences.en: doesn't even pay attention to it because the U.S.
sentences.zh: 甚至都不去关注它，因为美国

sentences.en: has a bad health care system.
sentences.zh: 拥有糟糕的医疗系统。

sentences.en: And so it could be that it was in the U.S.
sentences.zh: 所以这可能是因为它已经在美国

sentences.en: for a while and then it came over.
sentences.zh: 存在了一段时间，然后传了过来。

sentences.en: And then there's this sort of more pernicious rumor that a number of
sentences.zh: 然后还有这种更具恶意的谣言，许多

sentences.en: Chinese officials seem to endorse.
sentences.zh: 中国官员似乎对此表示赞同。

sentences.en: Pointed to this tweet from a spokesman for China's
sentences.zh: 指向了中国外交部

sentences.en: Ministry of Foreign Affairs saying, quote, it might be U.S.
sentences.zh: 发言人的一条推文，引用原话：可能是美军

sentences.en: Army who brought the epidemic to
sentences.zh: 把疫情带到了

sentences.en: Wuhan.
sentences.zh: 武汉。

sentences.en: Be transparent.
sentences.zh: 保持透明。

sentences.en: Make public your data.
sentences.zh: 公布你们的数据。

sentences.en: U.S.
sentences.zh: 美国

sentences.en: owe us an explanation.
sentences.zh: 欠我们一个解释。

sentences.en: Which is that the U.S.
sentences.zh: 也就是美军

sentences.en: military brought it to Wuhan because Wuhan had this military games last year.
sentences.zh: 把它带到了武汉，因为武汉去年举办了军运会。

sentences.en: The inflammatory tweet echoed a Canada-based conspiracy website's unsubstantiated claims that America was the real source of the coronavirus, apparently linking it to the U.S.
sentences.zh: 这篇煽动性的推文呼应了一个总部设在加拿大的阴谋论网站毫无根据的说法，即美国是冠状病毒的真正来源，显然将其与美军

sentences.en: Army's participation in the military world games.
sentences.zh: 参加世界军运会联系在了一起。

sentences.en: And that during that, a U.S.
sentences.zh: 并且在此期间，一名美军

sentences.en: military representative might have brought it and released it into the city.
sentences.zh: 军事代表可能把它带进来并释放到了这座城市。

sentences.en: And these are not, you know, small things.
sentences.zh: 这些可不是，你知道的，小事。

sentences.en: This is loud enough that a lot of my
sentences.zh: 声音大到我的很多

sentences.en: Chinese friends are asking me, hey, what do you think about this?
sentences.zh: 中国朋友都在问我，嘿，你怎么看这个？

sentences.en: Could this be right?
sentences.zh: 这可能是真的吗？

sentences.en: Oh, wow.
sentences.zh: 哦，哇。

sentences.en: And then what starts happening on state media is that you start hearing about cases being imported back into China from the world.
sentences.zh: 然后官方媒体开始出现的情况是，你开始听到病例从世界各地输入回中国的消息。

sentences.en: They're not specifying who's bringing these things back.
sentences.zh: 他们没有具体说明是谁把这些东西带回来的。

sentences.en: And oftentimes it's Chinese who live overseas or who are traveling overseas who got infected and came back.
sentences.zh: 而且往往是在海外生活或在海外旅行感染后回国的中国人。

sentences.en: But oftentimes state media just describes this as, you know, foreign cases.
sentences.zh: 但官媒往往只是将其描述为，你知道的，境外输入病例。

sentences.en: And so if you're seeing that every day and you're a regular Chinese person, you start to fear seeing a foreigner because
sentences.zh: 所以如果你每天都看到这些，而你又是一个普通的中国人，你就会开始害怕看到外国人，因为

sentences.en: you assume those foreigners, they're the ones who are bringing the cases back.
sentences.zh: 你认为那些外国人，就是他们把病例带了回来。

sentences.en: So I don't have to worry about anything but people coming from abroad.
sentences.zh: 所以我不用担心别的，只需要担心从国外回来的人就行了。

sentences.en: And who else comes from abroad but foreigners?
sentences.zh: 除了外国人，还有谁是从国外来的呢？

sentences.en: So the Chinese government's tolerance for and even promotion of these conspiracy theories that
sentences.zh: 因此，中国政府对这些阴谋论的容忍甚至推波助澜——即

sentences.en: the coronavirus didn't start in China, but perhaps started in the West and a place like America,
sentences.zh: 冠状病毒并非起源于中国，而是可能起源于西方和美国这样的地方，

sentences.en: that in turn is going to foment xenophobia, fear naturally of Westerners who Chinese people think will be carrying the virus.
sentences.zh: 这反过来又会煽动仇外情绪，让中国人自然而然地对那些他们认为会携带病毒的西方人产生恐惧。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And not just Westerners, too.
sentences.zh: 而且不仅仅是西方人。

sentences.en: I mean, anybody who could be perceived as not being from
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，任何在此时被认为不是来自

sentences.en: China at this point.
sentences.zh: 中国的人。

sentences.en: Africans living in Guangzhou say that they're being kicked out of their homes and face harassment as health workers step up testing for imported infections.
sentences.zh: 居住在广州的非洲人表示，随着卫生工作者加大对输入性感染检测的力度，他们被赶出家园并面临骚扰。

sentences.en: In southern China, where there's a large African community, a large number of Africans are evicted from their homes out of fear and hotels won't have them.
sentences.zh: 在中国南方，那里有一个庞大的非洲社群，由于恐惧，大量非洲人被驱逐出家园，酒店也不接待他们。

sentences.en: So they're sleeping on the streets.
sentences.zh: 所以他们只能睡在街上。

sentences.en: African diplomats are trying to deal with this, but they're shouted down.
sentences.zh: 非洲外交官正试图处理这件事，但他们遭到大声呵斥。

sentences.en: McDonald's and other restaurants won't let black people in.
sentences.zh: 麦当劳和其他餐馆不让黑人进入。

sentences.en: The United States issues an actual diplomatic warning to
sentences.zh: 美国发布了一则切实的领事警告

sentences.en: African-Americans saying, avoid this area because of the xenophobia and racism.
sentences.zh: 给非裔美国人，称：由于排外和种族主义，请避开该地区。

sentences.en: And so you just see this sort of snowballing effect of this fear growing and growing.
sentences.zh: 所以你就会看到这种恐惧不断滚雪球般越来越大的效应。

sentences.en: All of the fear of the foreigners related to the virus starts to tie into nationalism and a national self-image, all of which has been
sentences.zh: 所有与病毒相关的对外国人的恐惧，开始与民族主义和国家自我形象交织在一起，所有这些都是

sentences.en: carefully cultivated by the Chinese Communist Party and the Chinese government.
sentences.zh: 由中国共产党和中国政府精心培育的。

sentences.en: Paul, why would it be in China's interest to basically promote the xenophobia right now?
sentences.zh: 保罗，中国现在推动排外情绪能有什么好处呢？

sentences.en: So this is an old trick that the Chinese Communist Party has used in the paSt. Whenever there's a fear
sentences.zh: 所以这是中国共产党过去常用的一种老把戏。每当人们担心

sentences.en: that, you know, the legitimacy of the their rule is threatened, if people start to point the fingers at top leaders, they need to find somebody else to blame.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，他们的统治合法性受到威胁，如果人们开始把矛头指向最高领导人，他们就需要找另一个人来背锅。

sentences.en: And the easiest is foreigners, foreign influence, and often the United States.
sentences.zh: 而最简单的方法就是找外国人、外国势力，通常是美国。

sentences.en: So if we go back to last year, one of the biggest stories here was the Hong Kong protests.
sentences.zh: 所以如果我们回到去年，这里最大的新闻之一就是香港抗议活动。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: You know, and for month after month, you know, the front of newspapers on TV, we just saw, you know, fiery clashes, tear gas, police shooting protesters.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，而且连续好几个月，你知道的，报纸头版、电视上，我们看到的都是，你知道的，激烈的冲突、催泪瓦斯、警察向抗议者开枪。

sentences.en: This is hugely embarrassing.
sentences.zh: 这极其令人尴尬。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And so what does the Chinese Communist Party do?
sentences.zh: 那么中国共产党会怎么做？

sentences.en: They blame the protests on the United States and on the
sentences.zh: 他们把抗议活动归咎于美国和

sentences.en: WeSt. They say the United States is fomenting this and it's, you know, an aggressive act against
sentences.zh: 西方。他们说美国在煽动这一切，你知道的，这是针对

sentences.en: China.
sentences.zh: 中国的挑衅行为。

sentences.en: And so then throughout the year as well, we did a lot of coverage of what was going on in
sentences.zh: 所以在这一年中，我们也对

sentences.en: Western China and Xinjiang.
sentences.zh: 中国西部和新疆的情况进行了大量报道。

sentences.en: More than a million Uyghurs and others belonging to various Muslim minority groups are believed to be detained in the Xinjiang region.
sentences.zh: 据信有超过一百万维吾尔族人和其他属于各个穆斯林少数民族的人被关押在新疆地区。

sentences.en: Into a vast network of detention centers for what China calls re-education.
sentences.zh: 关押在一个庞大的拘留中心网络中，接受中国所称的再教育。

sentences.en: Where, you know, more than a million minority Uyghurs have been held in camps.
sentences.zh: 在这里，你知道的，超过一百万少数民族维吾尔人被关押在营地里。

sentences.en: And for that, too, you know, it gets tons of attention and people are talking about it all over the world.
sentences.zh: 对于这一点，你知道的，它也得到了极大的关注，世界各地的人们都在谈论它。

sentences.en: And so, again, they have to find an excuse and they say, well, you know, foreign forces and the Western media are making this up and they're trying to blacken China and tar China.
sentences.zh: 所以，同样地，他们必须寻找借口，他们说，嗯，你知道的，外国势力和西方媒体在捏造这些，他们试图抹黑和诋毁中国。

sentences.en: And so then, you know, we get to this year and out of nowhere comes this virus.
sentences.zh: 所以然后，你知道的，我们到了今年，这个病毒毫无征兆地出现了。

sentences.en: And what becomes very clear is that there's quite the cover up at the beginning.
sentences.zh: 非常明显的是，一开始存在相当严重的隐瞒。

sentences.en: And so, again, we're relentless in our coverage.
sentences.zh: 所以，同样地，我们的报道毫不手软。

sentences.en: We put this on the front page.
sentences.zh: 我们把它放在头版。

sentences.en: We dissect meticulously how this happened and what happened.
sentences.zh: 我们一丝不苟地剖析这是如何发生的以及发生了什么。

sentences.en: And again, the Chinese government sees this as
sentences.zh: 中国政府再次将此视为

sentences.en: uncompromisingly aggressive and just an embarrassment.
sentences.zh: 毫不妥协的挑衅，简直是一种尴尬。

sentences.en: And so, once again, how else can you kind of explain it all except to kind of turn the tables and blame, you know, foreign influences?
sentences.zh: 所以，再一次，除了扭转乾坤并归咎于，你知道的，外国势力，你还能怎么解释这一切呢？

sentences.en: And so, you know, we see this pattern where we're a thorn in their side and they ultimately blame us.
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道的，我们看到了这种模式，我们成了他们的眼中钉，而他们最终把责任归咎于我们。

sentences.en: You know, and under Chinese leader Xi Jinping, there's been this idea that China is now a superpower and that the world needs to take China into account.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，在中国领导人习近平的领导下，出现了一种观点，即中国现在是一个超级大国，世界需要把中国考虑在内。

sentences.en: They need to listen to what China has to say.
sentences.zh: 他们需要倾听中国的声音。

sentences.en: China will be at the table and they should respect China.
sentences.zh: 中国将参与其中，他们应该尊重中国。

sentences.en: And I think over and over again, we see in Xi Jinping's China, there's less and less room for anything that challenges that idea.
sentences.zh: 我想一次又一次地，我们在习近平的中国看到，对任何挑战这种观点的东西，容忍的空间越来越小。

sentences.en: And so, now we're at a place where one more group of people who would challenge this idea are gone.
sentences.zh: 所以，现在我们到了这样一个地方，又有一群会挑战这种观点的人消失了。

sentences.en: Meaning the foreign media.
sentences.zh: 指的是外国媒体。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: What the Chinese government wants to tell is a story of triumph.
sentences.zh: 中国政府想要讲述的是一个关于凯旋的故事。

sentences.en: They've emerged from the virus as the rest of the world is under siege and under lockdown.
sentences.zh: 当世界其他地方处于围困和封锁之中时，他们从病毒中走了出来。

sentences.en: And the story they want to tell is that the reason they were able to beat the virus is the superiority of the Chinese system.
sentences.zh: 他们想讲述的故事是，他们能够战胜病毒的原因是中国制度的优越性。

sentences.en: This sort of enlightened authoritarianism that is able to technocratically manage every variable and fix everything and make things right.
sentences.zh: 这种开明的威权主义，能够以技术官僚的方式管理每一个变量，解决所有问题，让一切恢复正常。

sentences.en: And when they look around the world, they can point and say, look at all these democracies.
sentences.zh: 当他们环顾世界时，他们可以指出来说，看看所有这些民主国家。

sentences.en: They're suffering terribly.
sentences.zh: 它们正遭受着可怕的痛苦。

sentences.en: More people are dying.
sentences.zh: 更多的人在死去。

sentences.en: More people are sick.
sentences.zh: 更多的人病了。

sentences.en: They're in crisis.
sentences.zh: 它们陷入了危机。

sentences.en: And we're we're we've gotten through this.
sentences.zh: 而我们，我们已经熬过来了。

sentences.en: We we succeeded.
sentences.zh: 我们成功了。

sentences.en: That means, you know, we are the new superpower.
sentences.zh: 这意味着，你知道的，我们是新的超级大国。

sentences.en: We are the sort of country in ascendancy and everybody must pay their respects now.
sentences.zh: 我们是那种正在崛起的国家，现在每个人都必须表示敬意。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And of course, the one thing that could get in the way of that, that idealized version of that story that China
sentences.zh: 当然，唯一可能阻碍这一点的事情，也就是中国那个理想化的叙事版本——

sentences.en: conquered this virus and did better with it than the West are a bunch of Western reporters poking around, finding examples of failure or finding the reemergence of the virus.
sentences.zh: 即中国战胜了病毒，并且处理得比西方更好——就是一群西方记者四处探访，寻找失败的例子或病毒复发的证据。

sentences.en: I mean, that just is incompatible with that story.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这与那个叙事完全是水火不容的。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 确实如此。

sentences.en: Paul, correct me if I'm wrong.
sentences.zh: 保罗，如果我没记错的话，请纠正我。

sentences.en: At this point, there's still an order telling you that you need to leave China.
sentences.zh: 此时此刻，依然有一道命令要求你离开中国。

sentences.en: This unsuccessful reporting trip has come to an end.
sentences.zh: 这次不成功的采访之旅已经结束了。

sentences.en: So where are you in your process of being expelled?
sentences.zh: 那么你目前的驱逐流程进展到哪一步了？

sentences.en: So this is sort of the end of March.
sentences.zh: 所以这大约是在三月底。

sentences.en: And the thing is, you know, the virus is spreading around the world and countries are closing their borders to foreigners.
sentences.zh: 问题是，你知道的，病毒正在世界各地蔓延，各国都在对外国人关闭边境。

sentences.en: So if I want to go anywhere outside of the United States and, you know, be in the same time zone and continue to cover China, I need to leave quicker.
sentences.zh: 所以如果我想去美国以外的任何地方，你知道的，还要在相同的时区并继续报道中国，我就必须更快地离开。

sentences.en: And so I actually ended up leaving just a few days later, much faster than I thought I would.
sentences.zh: 因此我实际上在几天后就匆忙离开了，比我预想的要快得多。

sentences.en: And so, you know, I pack up my stuff.
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道的，我收拾好行李。

sentences.en: I, you know, walk out the door.
sentences.zh: 我，你知道的，走出了门。

sentences.en: Taking one last look.
sentences.zh: 最后回头看了一眼。

sentences.en: I leave my apartment.
sentences.zh: 我离开了我的公寓。

sentences.en: And I head for the airport for a final flight out of a country that has held my imagination and just
sentences.zh: 我前往机场，准备搭乘最后一趟航班离开这个让我魂牵梦萦、

sentences.en: captured my attention and just been so, you know, incredibly interesting that it's been impossible to leave for 15 years.
sentences.zh: 吸引了我的目光、而且实在是——你知道的——如此不可思议地有趣，以至于我15年来都无法离开的国家。

sentences.en: I get on a flight and leave it for what will probably be the final time in a long time.
sentences.zh: 我登上了飞机，离开了它，这很可能是在很长一段时间内的最后一次。

sentences.en: And I find myself a few hours later in Japan.
sentences.zh: 几个小时后，我发现自己身处日本。

sentences.en: And I get through just before the borders are closing to Americans and start a two week quarantine and a new life outside of China.
sentences.zh: 我赶在对美国人关闭边境前的最后关头入境，开始了两周的隔离，以及在中国之外的新生活。

sentences.en: I mean, I can't imagine that it's easy or even really possible to cover China from outside of China, right?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我无法想象在中国境外报道中国会是容易的，甚至真的可能吗，对吧？

sentences.en: Yeah, it's a different sort of thing.
sentences.zh: 是的，那是完全不同的一回事。

sentences.en: I think one of the really important things about having journalists in China is that for all of the propaganda and all of the intimidation,
sentences.zh: 我认为在中国驻留记者非常重要的一点在于，尽管有所有的宣传和恐吓，

sentences.en: Chinese people still want to talk.
sentences.zh: 中国人民仍然想要说话。

sentences.en: They love telling stories.
sentences.zh: 他们喜欢讲述故事。

sentences.en: They love talking about what their experiences are.
sentences.zh: 他们喜欢谈论自己的经历。

sentences.en: And one of our best ways to just find out what was happening is to go to places and talk to regular people.
sentences.zh: 而我们了解发生了什么事的最好方法之一，就是去到实地，与普通人交谈。

sentences.en: And now that that avenue is cut off to us.
sentences.zh: 而现在，这条途径对我们被切断了。

sentences.en: And so we're going to be reliant on filings and government documents.
sentences.zh: 因此我们将不得不依赖官方申报和政府文件。

sentences.en: And we're just going to have a vaguer picture, a far less precise picture of what's going on in the place.
sentences.zh: 我们将只能得到一个更加模糊、远不够精确的画面，来了解那里正在发生的事情。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: At a moment when it would seem like the eyes and ears of journalists would be as essential as ever.
sentences.zh: 而在这样一个似乎比以往任何时候都更需要记者的耳目的时刻。

sentences.en: So how are you feeling about this?
sentences.zh: 所以你对此有什么感觉？

sentences.en: You know, it feels like it couldn't be at a worse time because now is the most important and most
sentences.zh: 你知道的，这感觉就像不会再有比这更糟糕的时机了，因为现在正是身处中国最重要、最

sentences.en: interesting moment to be in China because China is as powerful and as large as it's ever been.
sentences.zh: 有趣的时刻，因为中国比以往任何时候都更加强大和庞大。

sentences.en: And it's on this steep path of authoritarianism.
sentences.zh: 而且它正走在威权主义的陡峭道路上。

sentences.en: Xi Jinping will not step down the way previous presidents did.
sentences.zh: 习近平不会像前任主席那样卸任。

sentences.en: He will continue to push this triumphalism.
sentences.zh: 他将继续推行这种凯旋主义。

sentences.en: And where that goes and what it means for Chinese people and for the world is probably, in my mind, the most important story.
sentences.zh: 而这会走向何方，对中国人民和世界意味着什么，在我看来，可能是最重要的故事。

sentences.en: To not be able to be there to see it just feels like an irreparable loss.
sentences.zh: 无法身临其境去见证这一切，感觉就像是一种无法弥补的损失。

sentences.en: And it makes me feel, I guess, grateful for the time I had there.
sentences.zh: 这让我感到，我想，我很感激我在那里度过的时光。

sentences.en: Do you think, Paul, that when this is all over, this pandemic, and perhaps China reaches a point where this triumphalism has been achieved,
sentences.zh: 保罗，你认为当这一切结束时，这场大流行结束，或许中国达到了这种凯旋主义已经实现的阶段，

sentences.en: that things might return to the way that they were before all this for journalists like you and for the relationship between China and the West?
sentences.zh: 事情是否会回到这一切发生之前那种状态，对于像你这样的记者以及中国与西方的关系而言？

sentences.en: I really do think we've crossed a point in the U.S.-China relationship that will be difficult to come back from.
sentences.zh: 我真的认为我们在美中关系上已经跨过了一个难以回头的节点。

sentences.en: I think both countries have made it clear the way they view the world is at odds.
sentences.zh: 我认为两国都已经明确表示，他们看待世界的方式是针锋相对的。

sentences.en: And it's unfortunate because the one way we could get back to where there's more understanding is to have exchanges and to have people on the ground trying
sentences.zh: 这是不幸的，因为我们能够回到更多理解的唯一途径，就是进行交流，让实地人员去

sentences.en: to explain China to the United States and the United States to China.
sentences.zh: 向美国解释中国，并向中国解释美国。

sentences.en: And that's not happening?
sentences.zh: 而这并没有发生？

sentences.en: Yeah, that's not happening.
sentences.zh: 是的，这并没有发生。

sentences.en: And I don't see it getting better anytime soon.
sentences.zh: 而且我看不出它在短期内会有所改善。

sentences.en: Paul, thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 保罗，非常感谢你。

sentences.en: I know you don't really want to be in the position that you're in, but we wish you the very best of luck.
sentences.zh: 我知道你其实不想处于目前的境地，但我们祝你一切顺利。

sentences.en: Thanks.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天需要了解的其他内容。

sentences.en: U.S.
sentences.zh: 美国

sentences.en: retail sales, which include purchases in stores and online, as well as in restaurants and bars,
sentences.zh: 零售销售额，包括实体店和网购，以及餐馆和酒吧的消费，

sentences.en: experienced their largest monthly decline in three decades in March as lockdowns changed consumer behavior.
sentences.zh: 在三月份经历了三十年来最大的月度跌幅，因为封锁改变了消费者的行为。

sentences.en: The depth of the decline, nearly 9 percent according to the Commerce Department, is significant because the retail industry accounts for one out of every 10 American jobs.
sentences.zh: 根据商务部的数据，跌幅之深接近9%，这意义重大，因为零售业占美国所有工作岗位的十分之一。

sentences.en: April's retail sales may be even worse because state lockdowns have only intensified since March.
sentences.zh: 四月份的零售销售额可能会更糟糕，因为各州的封锁自三月以来进一步加剧。

sentences.en: And
sentences.zh: 并且

sentences.en: Among all the other candidates I competed with in the Democratic primary, there's no one I've agreed with 100 percent of the time over the years.
sentences.zh: 在我参与竞争民主党初选的所有其他候选人中，没有哪个人是我多年来能百分之百同意的。

sentences.en: But one thing I appreciate about Joe Biden is he will always tell you where he stands.
sentences.zh: 但我对乔·拜登有一点很欣赏，那就是他总是会表明自己的立场。

sentences.en: In a video released on Wednesday, Elizabeth Warren became the latest former rival to endorse
sentences.zh: 在周三发布的一段视频中，伊丽莎白·沃伦成为最新一位宣布支持

sentences.en: Joe Biden for president as the Democratic Party moves to coalesce around his candidacy.
sentences.zh: 乔·拜登竞选总统的前竞争对手，随着民主党正朝着凝聚在他的候选资格周围迈进。

sentences.en: When you disagree, he'll listen and not just listen, but really hear you and treat you with respect no matter where you're coming from.
sentences.zh: 当你不同意时，他会倾听，不仅是倾听，而且是真正地倾听你的心声，无论你来自哪里，都会以尊重对待你。

sentences.en: In the past week, both Bernie Sanders and former President Barack Obama have also endorsed Biden.
sentences.zh: 在过去的一周里，伯尼·桑德斯和前总统巴拉克·奥巴马也相继宣布支持拜登。

sentences.en: That's it for The Daily.
sentences.zh: 以上就是本期《每日新闻》。

sentences.en: I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是迈克尔·巴尔巴罗。

sentences.en: See you tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 明天见。

sentences.en: For decades, the Brooklyn Democratic Party operated as a tightly controlled machine until this summer,
sentences.zh: 几十年来，布鲁克林民主党一直作为一个受严密控制的机器在运作，直到今年夏天，

sentences.en: when elections ushered in a bunch of self-described reformers.
sentences.zh: 那时的选举迎进了一批自称改革派的人士。

sentences.en: Ever since, the party has been in the grip of a bruising, chaotic, and sometimes thrilling fight.
sentences.zh: 从那以后，该党就陷入了一场残酷、混乱、有时甚至令人惊心动魄的争斗之中。

sentences.zh: 在《都市》最新一期节目中，我和萨拉·凯尼格一起，为您讲述人们试图维持其影响力却在过程中失去控制的故事。
